verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document versioning, change review, or rollback for user automations such as Magic Skills. Pinning a provider deployment to a version (metorial-docs-8) controls integration updates, not automation versions. Reviewing traces after runs (metorial-docs-10) is execution auditing, not review of automation changes. Separate sandbox and production environments are related but different controls. Neither establishes rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
